crossRefs.note: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

translations.web: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.
translations.bsb: Insert the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, in order to carry it.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings by the sides of the ark, that the ark may be borne
translations.asv: And thou shalt put the staves into the rings on the sides of the ark, wherewith to bear the ark.
